finding.title: Null-dropping body members read unresolved in source coverage
finding.body: D-3avp7m and defaults.null_handling: omit make the connector drop an explicit null, written $args.x? (connectors-language.md § @connect body). source-coverage's request classifier does not parse the ? guard: post:/books/search query, genre, maxPriceCents; post:/orders payment.type, payment.last4, payment.brand, payment.iban; post:/orders/{orderId}/refund reason read unresolved. The $args { reason? } sub-selection form was tried for refundOrder and reads unaccounted, so the guard stays. These rows are not verified by the coverage layer; e2e (refund_order, refund_order_minimal, refund_order_null_reason, search_books_nulls, create_order_nulls) and the write-body proof are what prove them. Replaces F-p8a153, whose patch:/orders/{orderId} row went with the API 2.0.0 removal.
